name: Text cleaner
summary: Clean text: remove duplicate lines, sort, trim
author: friday-core
description: Cleans pasted text and lists exactly, which a model does unreliably on long input: trim, collapse spaces, remove blank or duplicate lines (case-insensitive, first kept), sort A-Z or Z-A, strip bullets and numbering, straighten curly quotes and dashes, number the lines, change case, reverse the order or join lines. Say what to do on the first line and paste the text below it.
